definition: The number of times a value, or a value inside a class, occurs in a data set.
A table that lists each value, or each class of values, beside the number of times it occurs.
A group of values in a grouped frequency table, written as an inequality such as $20 \le t < 25$, so that every value falls in exactly one class.
A diagram for grouped data with one bar per class on a continuous scale; with equal class widths, each bar's height is the class frequency and neighbouring bars touch.
A distribution that is not symmetric because one side trails off in a long tail: a long tail to the right is positive skew, to the left negative skew.
The number of data values less than or equal to a given value: the running total of the frequencies.
The $k$th percentile is the value with $k\%$ of the data below it; the median is the 50th percentile.
The smallest value, lower quartile, median, upper quartile and largest value of a data set.
A diagram of a data set drawn to scale, with a box from the lower to the upper quartile, a line at the median, whiskers to the most extreme values that are not outliers, and a cross for each outlier.
